name: bespunky-workflow
description: How work moves from idea to production. branch-and-release: a declared branch model, per-feature worktrees, human-gated moves. local-server-isolation: random free test ports. feature-package: one effort, one slug, one folder of durable docs. session-handoff: relay a live effort to a fresh session. project-standing: orient in a project after a gap. delegate-and-parallelize: orchestrate budgeted subagents. sanity-review: specialised agents critique and fix finished work before handing back.
